{{nihongo|'''Mishima Shrine (Minamiizu-chō Nijō)'''|三島神社 (南伊豆町二條)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Mishima Shrine''' (みしまじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Minamiizu|Q1203741|qid=Q1203741}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|Q961511|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4401110 三島神社] - Shizuoka Prefectural Shrine Office</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It is enshrined in an exclave of the Nijō district, just north of the town library, north of the Kamo district that forms the center of Minamiizu.

Its founding is unknown, but it is an old shrine identified as one of the two seats of '''Kamo Shrine''' (かもじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and is also recorded in the ''{{ill|Izu no Kuni Shinkaichō|Q17193087|qid=Q17193087}}'' as "Junior Fourth Rank Upper, Kamo no Myōjin"<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/misima6_title.htm 三島神社] - Genbu</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140143-03.html 三島神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was listed as a village shrine<ref name="engi"/>.

* {{ill|Tamakushi-hime|ja|玉櫛媛|zh|玉依媛|qid=Q11572681|lt=Mizokui-hime-no-Mikoto}}
